images.title: Image folder(s)
images.description: Folder(s) of microscope images. Every image file inside (any depth) is offered to the pipeline; its own Images and NamesAndTypes rules decide what is used.

pipeline.title: CellProfiler pipeline (.cppipe)
pipeline.description: Your CellProfiler pipeline (.cppipe, from File > Export > Pipeline). It must use Images/NamesAndTypes (not LoadData) and have an ExportToSpreadsheet module.

title.title: Viewer title
title.description: Title shown at the top of the results viewer

chunk_size.title: Image sets per task
chunk_size.description: Image sets per parallel task. Pipelines with Groups enabled run one task per group instead.
